dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「さすがに慌ただしくなってきましたね」
dialogues.en:
For me, it's nothing drastic. After graduation I'll just be
studying in different buildings because I'm simply moving to
the main campus, which is right next door.
dialogues.text:
For me, it's nothing drastic. After graduation I'll just be
studying in different buildings because I'm simply moving to
the main campus, which is right next door.

dialogues.jp:
放課後、暦先生が職員会議なのをいいことに、
準備室で美春とお茶を飲んでいた。
dialogues.en: I'll even have the same teachers...
dialogues.text: I'll even have the same teachers...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あー、もう明後日ですか」
dialogues.en: "Ah... I wish I could wear that uniform soon."
dialogues.text: "Ah... I wish I could wear that uniform soon."

dialogues.jp:
付属から本校に進学する場合、結局、教室が変
わる程度でそれ以外は、何ひとつ変わらない。
dialogues.en: "You're not graduating yet..."
dialogues.text: "You're not graduating yet..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あー、美春も早く本校の制服着たいなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Heehee."
dialogues.text: "Heehee."

dialogues.jp: 美春がそう言って笑みをこぼす。
dialogues.en: Miharu smiles.
dialogues.text: Miharu smiles.

dialogues.jp:
「昔はさ、時間が経つのがすごく遅いって感じ
　てたんだけど、なんだか、今年は早かったよ
　うな気がするよ」
dialogues.en:
"I always thought time was passing too slowly, but this year
I feel like it went too fast."
dialogues.text:
"I always thought time was passing too slowly, but this year
I feel like it went too fast."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「卒業生は、みんなそう言うんだよ」
dialogues.en: "All the graduates say the same."
dialogues.text: "All the graduates say the same."

dialogues.jp: がらりとドアを開けて暦先生が入ってくる。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei comes into the room.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei comes into the room.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いろいろ身の回りに変化が出るからね。やる
　ことが増えて、忙しいと感じれば、時間が短
　く思えるものさ」
dialogues.en:
"It's because things around you start to change. The busier
you get, the faster you feel time goes."
dialogues.text:
"It's because things around you start to change. The busier
you get, the faster you feel time goes."

dialogues.jp:
先生がポケットから出したタバコの封を開け、
１本を口にくわえる。
dialogues.en: She puts a cigarette into her mouth.
dialogues.text: She puts a cigarette into her mouth.

dialogues.jp:
そして、相変わらず｛・・・・／まずそう｝な顔をして、嬉し
そうにケムリを吐く。
dialogues.en:
She makes faces while inhaling and looks satisfied when
exhaling.
dialogues.text:
She makes faces while inhaling and looks satisfied when
exhaling.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなものですかね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そういうものだよ。おかげで、あたしもいつ
　の間にかこんな歳に……」
dialogues.en: "That's why before I knew it, I've become this old."
dialogues.text: "That's why before I knew it, I've become this old."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど。含蓄がありますね」
dialogues.en: "You're not that old."
dialogues.text: "You're not that old."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「こら、そこで妙に感心しないように」
dialogues.en: "Age doesn't matter. People get old anyways."
dialogues.text: "Age doesn't matter. People get old anyways."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、年齢なんか関係ないな。やれハタチだ、
　やれミソジだなんて、誰にでも訪れることだ
　しね」
dialogues.en:
"The point is, I think, whether you can live up to your
age."
dialogues.text:
"The point is, I think, whether you can live up to your
age."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「要は、自分が年齢に見合った生き方をしてる
　かどうかだと思うよ、あたしは」
dialogues.en: "That's very philosophical..."
dialogues.text: "That's very philosophical..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「やけに哲学的ですね……」
dialogues.en: "I've lived this long..."
dialogues.text: "I've lived this long..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「これだけ長く生きてるとねぇ……」
dialogues.en: "But you aren't that old..."
dialogues.text: "But you aren't that old..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: （いや、そうしみじみと語られても……）
dialogues.en:
"All I wanted to say is, seize the day -- live each day with
no regrets."
dialogues.text:
"All I wanted to say is, seize the day -- live each day with
no regrets."

dialogues.jp:
リアクションのしようがないぞ。ヘタなことを
言ったら本校でイジメられそうだし。
dialogues.en: "Yes, ma'am."
dialogues.text: "Yes, ma'am."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、いい話のような、そうでないような
不思議な話だったな。
dialogues.en: I think I get it... I think...
dialogues.text: I think I get it... I think...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ天枷。タバコ買ってきてくれないか？
　いつものやつを頼む」
dialogues.en: "Miharu, can you buy me a pack of cigarettes?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu, can you buy me a pack of cigarettes?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いいですよ」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生はそう言って、財布から小銭を取り出し、
美春に握らせた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei gives Miharu some coins.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei gives Miharu some coins.

dialogues.jp: 準備室には、俺と暦先生だけになった。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei and I are left in the room.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei and I are left in the room.

dialogues.jp: 「なんか、俺に話でもあるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to talk to me about something, Koyomi-sensei?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to talk to me about something, Koyomi-sensei?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なんで？」
dialogues.en: "Why?"
dialogues.text: "Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「美春にタバコを買いに行かせたじゃないです
　か。さっき、新しいの開けたばかりなのに」
dialogues.en:
"You just sent Miharu off to buy a pack of cigarettes,
although you just opened a new pack a minute ago."
dialogues.text:
"You just sent Miharu off to buy a pack of cigarettes,
although you just opened a new pack a minute ago."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……ヤなトコばっかり見てるね」
dialogues.en: "What were you looking at anyway?"
dialogues.text: "What were you looking at anyway?"

dialogues.jp: 先生はそう言って、タバコを吹かした。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei exhales.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei exhales.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「何てことはないんだけど、その後、どうなっ
　たか経過が聞きたくてさ」
dialogues.en: "I just wanted to know how it's going since then."
dialogues.text: "I just wanted to know how it's going since then."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「結局……美春は今まで通りにするそうです。
　みんなのために生きるほうがいいって」
dialogues.en:
"Miharu's adamant about the way she has been living. She
prefers to live for others."
dialogues.text:
"Miharu's adamant about the way she has been living. She
prefers to live for others."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「だろうと思ったよ」
dialogues.en: "I kind of knew it."
dialogues.text: "I kind of knew it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「だろうと思ったって……」
dialogues.en: "You knew it...?"
dialogues.text: "You knew it...?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「思い出探しは、寿命を削るって言っただろ。
　でも本人には、やめる気がない」
dialogues.en:
"You told her that looking for her memories will cut her
life short. But she insists on doing it no matter what,
Right?"
dialogues.text:
"You told her that looking for her memories will cut her
life short. But she insists on doing it no matter what,
Right?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「普通、ロボットってのは、自分の命を危険に
　さらす行為は、しないようにできてるんだ」
dialogues.en: "Generally, robots are built not to risk their lives."
dialogues.text: "Generally, robots are built not to risk their lives."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ナントカ三原則ってヤツですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that the three whatever principles?"
dialogues.text: "Is that the three whatever principles?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いやいや、『人間のために』って言うんじゃ
　なくて、造ったモノに勝手に壊れられちゃ、
　困るでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"No. It's not for the sake of humans. We simply don't want
robots to shut themselves down."
dialogues.text:
"No. It's not for the sake of humans. We simply don't want
robots to shut themselves down."

dialogues.jp: まあ、確かにそうだけど。
dialogues.en: Well, that makes sense.
dialogues.text: Well, that makes sense.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「天枷には一応、そういうプロテクトはかけて
　あるんだけどね」
dialogues.en:
"I put a preventive system inside of Amakase so that she
won't shut herself down."
dialogues.text:
"I put a preventive system inside of Amakase so that she
won't shut herself down."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「みんなのために生きたいっていうのは、美春
　の強い願いだから。俺はあいつのそういうと
　ころが好きになったんだし……」
dialogues.en:
"Living for others is such a strong desire for her. I was
attracted by her big heart."
dialogues.text:
"Living for others is such a strong desire for her. I was
attracted by her big heart."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「言うねぇ……」
dialogues.en: "There you go..."
dialogues.text: "There you go..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ……いや」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いいよ、いいよ。あたしも研究者冥利に尽き
　るってものだよ。それだけ好きになってもら
　えればさ」
dialogues.en: "It's okay, because that means you like my work."
dialogues.text: "It's okay, because that means you like my work."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「とにかく、そういうプロテクトを外してまで
　そう思ってるんだ。天枷の頭脳はあたしが考
　えているよりもずっと変化しているらしい」
dialogues.en:
"At any rate, she thinks that way even though the preventive
system is there. It seems her brain functions are changing a
lot more than I initially thought."
dialogues.text:
"At any rate, she thinks that way even though the preventive
system is there. It seems her brain functions are changing a
lot more than I initially thought."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「先生……美春を止めないでやってください。
　たぶんあいつはあいつなりに考えて、そうし
　てるんだと思うんです」
dialogues.en:
"Koyomi-sensei, please don't let Miharu shut herself down.
She knows what she's doing."
dialogues.text:
"Koyomi-sensei, please don't let Miharu shut herself down.
She knows what she's doing."

dialogues.jp:
きっと、先生は俺に美春を止めるように説得し
ようとして、わざと、ふたりきりになったんだ
と思う。
dialogues.en:
I know Koyomi-sensei wanted me to talk Miharu out of looking
for her memories.
dialogues.text:
I know Koyomi-sensei wanted me to talk Miharu out of looking
for her memories.

dialogues.jp:
でも、俺はやっぱり美春には美春の思うように
生きてほしいと思っている。俺だって色々考え
た結果だ。
dialogues.en:
But I want her to live her life to the fullest. This is my
decision.
dialogues.text:
But I want her to live her life to the fullest. This is my
decision.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ははは、今さらもう止められないさ。と言う
　よりも、もう止まらないと言ったほうが正し
　いかな」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha. We can't stop Amakase now. The damage to her body
is worse than you think."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha. We can't stop Amakase now. The damage to her body
is worse than you think."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「天枷の身体へのダメージは朝倉が想像してい
　るより随分大きいんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm proud that I built her, although all I really did was
the design of her basic systems."
dialogues.text:
"I'm proud that I built her, although all I really did was
the design of her basic systems."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そう……なんですか」
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei lights up her second cigarette.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei lights up her second cigarette.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしは短い時間だったけど、あの子を世に
　送り出せて誇らしいと思ってるよ。もっとも
　造ったのは基本システムの部分だけだけど」
dialogues.en:
"I double-checked, and I was right. There are no memories in
her system."
dialogues.text:
"I double-checked, and I was right. There are no memories in
her system."

dialogues.jp: 先生は２本目のタバコに火をつける。
dialogues.en: "No memories?"
dialogues.text: "No memories?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ただ、色々調べたけど、やっぱり記憶はない
　という結論に達しているけどね」
dialogues.en:
"I couldn't find any data that would explain what you and
Amakase saw."
dialogues.text:
"I couldn't find any data that would explain what you and
Amakase saw."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「何かわかったんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"I only found simple, ordinary data in Amakase's memory
system."
dialogues.text:
"I only found simple, ordinary data in Amakase's memory
system."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、結局、天枷や朝倉が言うようなデータ
　はどこにも見当たらないんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"If she really had Miharu Amakase's memory data, then we
would be able to find it because the recording system is
different between the two of them. But we didn't find any
differences."
dialogues.text:
"If she really had Miharu Amakase's memory data, then we
would be able to find it because the recording system is
different between the two of them. But we didn't find any
differences."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん、天枷の記憶データの中にはそれら
　しいものがあるんだけど、それはいわゆる日
　常のデータと同じでさ」
dialogues.en: "Where did the memory she got back come from then?"
dialogues.text: "Where did the memory she got back come from then?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「『天枷美春』のデータだとしたら、なんらか
　の差異があるはずなんだ。記録方式が違うん
　だから」
dialogues.en:
"It could've been her imagination. She might just be
thinking of it as her memory."
dialogues.text:
"It could've been her imagination. She might just be
thinking of it as her memory."

dialogues.jp: 画像のない夢。ただのイメージだけの夢。
dialogues.en: The dream had no movement -- only an image.
dialogues.text: The dream had no movement -- only an image.

dialogues.jp: 俺の見た美春の夢は、そんな｛あいまい／曖昧｝なものだ。
dialogues.en: That's what I saw in Miharu's dream.
dialogues.text: That's what I saw in Miharu's dream.

dialogues.jp: 実際に｛・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・・／子供の俺や子供の美春はいなかった｝。
dialogues.en: In fact, I couldn't even see me or Miharu.
dialogues.text: In fact, I couldn't even see me or Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「たぶん、天枷はよほど辛かったんだろう。み
　んなを騙してる気がしてさ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sure Miharu is struggling emotionally because she feels
like she's lying to us."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sure Miharu is struggling emotionally because she feels
like she's lying to us."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あいつは優しいヤツだから……」
dialogues.en: "Miharu is such a kindhearted person..."
dialogues.text: "Miharu is such a kindhearted person..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、後のことは任せるよ。あたしも覚悟がつ
　いたから、その話をしようと思っただけだし」
dialogues.en:
"I'll leave the rest up to you, Asakura, because now I'm
ready for the worst. That's all I wanted to tell you."
dialogues.text:
"I'll leave the rest up to you, Asakura, because now I'm
ready for the worst. That's all I wanted to tell you."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい。ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Do you wanna smoke?"
dialogues.text: "Do you wanna smoke?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、先生にぺこりと頭を下げた。
dialogues.en: "Uh, no... I don't think that's a good idea..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, no... I don't think that's a good idea..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「――礼を言われるほどのことじゃないさ」
dialogues.en:
"I know. Just wanted to say it. It'd make you feel good, you
know?"
dialogues.text:
"I know. Just wanted to say it. It'd make you feel good, you
know?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ただいま帰りましたー」
dialogues.en: "I'm back!"
dialogues.text: "I'm back!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、お帰り。ありがとう。お釣りは間違え
　てないだろうね」
dialogues.en: "Welcome back. Thanks. You got the right change?"
dialogues.text: "Welcome back. Thanks. You got the right change?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫ですよ。子供じゃないんですから」
dialogues.en: "Of course. I'm not a child."
dialogues.text: "Of course. I'm not a child."

dialogues.jp: 美春がそう言って、小銭とタバコを渡す。
dialogues.en:
Miharu gives Koyomi-sensei a pack of cigarettes and the
change.
dialogues.text:
Miharu gives Koyomi-sensei a pack of cigarettes and the
change.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、先輩。そろそろ帰りましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Sempai, shall we go home now?"
dialogues.text: "Sempai, shall we go home now?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、席を立ち、鞄を持つ。
dialogues.en: I stand up with the bag in my hand.
dialogues.text: I stand up with the bag in my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ白河先生。また明日」
dialogues.en: "See you tomorrow, Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text: "See you tomorrow, Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい。気をつけて帰りなよ」
dialogues.en: "Take care."
dialogues.text: "Take care."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はーい」
dialogues.en: "I will."
dialogues.text: "I will."

dialogues.jp:
美春は、いつものご機嫌な返事をすると、準備
室の扉を開けた。
dialogues.en: With a cheerful reply, Miharu opens the door.
dialogues.text: With a cheerful reply, Miharu opens the door.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉もな」
dialogues.en: "Take care, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Take care, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、さっき先生と何を話してたんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Sempai, what were you and Shirakawa-sensei talking about
while I was out?"
dialogues.text:
"Sempai, what were you and Shirakawa-sensei talking about
while I was out?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に」
dialogues.en: "Nothing..."
dialogues.text: "Nothing..."

dialogues.jp:
言えるわけがないよなぁ。美春の見た夢が思い
出なんかじゃないって。
dialogues.en:
How can I tell her that her dreams are in fact not her
memories?
dialogues.text:
How can I tell her that her dreams are in fact not her
memories?

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「もしかして、美春に話せないようなイケナイ
　内容ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, were you two talking about something you can't tell
me about?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, were you two talking about something you can't tell
me about?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「別にそんなやましい話はしてないよ。卒業し
　たらの話だよ。卒業したらの」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing like that. We were talking about my plans for after
graduation."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing like that. We were talking about my plans for after
graduation."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんですか。なんだか先生がいやに楽し
　そうな顔をしてたから、ちょっと気になって」
dialogues.en:
"I was just wondering about that, because sensei looked
really happy."
dialogues.text:
"I was just wondering about that, because sensei looked
really happy."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、担任だし、結構仲いいからなぁ。もし
　かして妬いてるのか？」
dialogues.en: "She's my homeroom teacher. Are you jealous?"
dialogues.text: "She's my homeroom teacher. Are you jealous?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんなことないですよぉ〜だ」
dialogues.en: "No way!"
dialogues.text: "No way!"

dialogues.jp:
美春があまりにも驚いた顔をしたので、それが
面白くて、ついケラケラと笑ってしまった。
dialogues.en: Miharu gives me a very surprised look, and so I laugh.
dialogues.text: Miharu gives me a very surprised look, and so I laugh.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「笑うなんてひどいですよぉ」
dialogues.en: "What are you laughing at?"
dialogues.text: "What are you laughing at?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「悪い悪い。公園でチョコバナナ｛おご／奢｝ってやるか
　ら、それで許してくれ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry. I'll buy you a chocolate banana at the park."
dialogues.text: "Sorry. I'll buy you a chocolate banana at the park."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「チョコバナナもですけど、あの大きな桜の木
　まで連れてってください」
dialogues.en:
"Can you take me to the place with the big cherry tree
again?"
dialogues.text:
"Can you take me to the place with the big cherry tree
again?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あそこへ？」
dialogues.en: "That place?"
dialogues.text: "That place?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あそこに行けば、何か思い出せるような気が
　するんです」
dialogues.en: "I feel like I'm remembering something there."
dialogues.text: "I feel like I'm remembering something there."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「何か思い出せる……ね」
dialogues.en: "Oh... are you?"
dialogues.text: "Oh... are you?"

dialogues.jp: 相変わらず、桜の花びらが渦巻いていた。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossom petals are whirling around in the wind.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossom petals are whirling around in the wind.

dialogues.jp: まるで雪の日のように、辺りを舞っている。
dialogues.en: Just like snow.
dialogues.text: Just like snow.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いつ来ても、ここは綺麗ですね……」
dialogues.en: "It's so beautiful here -- as always..."
dialogues.text: "It's so beautiful here -- as always..."

dialogues.jp:
息を飲むというのは、こういうことを言うのだ
ろう。
dialogues.en: This view literally takes my breath away.
dialogues.text: This view literally takes my breath away.

dialogues.jp:
何度か来ている俺でさえ、時々、目を奪われる
ことがある。
dialogues.en:
And I'm captivated by this view, no matter how many times I
come here and see it.
dialogues.text:
And I'm captivated by this view, no matter how many times I
come here and see it.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ここには素敵な思い出があると思うんです。
　どうしてかはわからないんですけど、なんだ
　か今までと違う感じがします」
dialogues.en:
"I feel like I have some fond memories here, which are quite
different from my memories of other places."
dialogues.text:
"I feel like I have some fond memories here, which are quite
different from my memories of other places."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「素敵な思い出かぁ」
dialogues.en: "Fond memories..."
dialogues.text: "Fond memories..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん、先輩との思い出……」
dialogues.en: "Probably, some memories with you, sempai."
dialogues.text: "Probably, some memories with you, sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「俺との？」
dialogues.en: "With me?"
dialogues.text: "With me?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「だって、ここは先輩の秘密の場所でしょ？」
dialogues.en: "This is your secret place, right?"
dialogues.text: "This is your secret place, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そういや、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, that's right."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, that's right."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「せめてひとつくらいは思い出が欲しいんです。
　『美春さん』としての記憶が……」
dialogues.en: "I want at least one memory... something as 'Miharu-san'..."
dialogues.text: "I want at least one memory... something as 'Miharu-san'..."

dialogues.jp: ――ざざん。
dialogues.en: Whoosh...
dialogues.text: Whoosh...

dialogues.jp: 風に揺れる木々。
dialogues.en: The trees sway in the wind.
dialogues.text: The trees sway in the wind.

dialogues.jp: 「美春、帰ろう」
dialogues.en: "Miharu, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Miharu, let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もう少し。もう少し、このまま」
dialogues.en: "Just a little bit longer. Just a little bit."
dialogues.text: "Just a little bit longer. Just a little bit."

dialogues.jp:
桜吹雪の中で、まるで美春が消えていくように
見える。
dialogues.en:
It seems like Miharu is disappearing into a sea of cherry
blossom petals, that are whirling around in the wind.
dialogues.text:
It seems like Miharu is disappearing into a sea of cherry
blossom petals, that are whirling around in the wind.

dialogues.jp: かき消えるように、それが当たり前のように。
dialogues.en: She seems to be fading away so naturally...
dialogues.text: She seems to be fading away so naturally...

dialogues.jp: 目の前を桜の花びらが覆っていく。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossom petals are veiling my eyes.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossom petals are veiling my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 覚悟はしたつもりだった。
dialogues.en: I thought I was emotionally prepared.
dialogues.text: I thought I was emotionally prepared.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、だからと言って、簡単に割り切れるも
のではない。
dialogues.en: But it's not as easy as I thought.
dialogues.text: But it's not as easy as I thought.

dialogues.jp: 頭で理解はしていても、感情は別だ。
dialogues.en: "Miharu!"
dialogues.text: "Miharu!"

dialogues.jp: 「美春！」
dialogues.en: I pull her by the hand and hold her from behind.
dialogues.text: I pull her by the hand and hold her from behind.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "S-Sempai..."
dialogues.text: "S-Sempai..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「『美春』の思い出も大事だけど、美春の思い
　出も大事だろ」
dialogues.en:
"I know Miharu's memories are important, but your own
memories are just as important."
dialogues.text:
"I know Miharu's memories are important, but your own
memories are just as important."

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅっと強く抱きしめる。この感触、この匂い。
決して失いたくない。
dialogues.en: I hold her tight. I don't want to forget how she feels.
dialogues.text: I hold her tight. I don't want to forget how she feels.

dialogues.jp: 「俺は、美春との思い出のほうがほしい……」
dialogues.en: "I want my memories with you, Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "I want my memories with you, Miharu..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は、自分に与えられた時間を精一杯生き
　たいと思ってます。先輩、もう少し美春に時
　間をください……」
dialogues.en:
"I want to live a meaningful life. Sempai, please give me
more time..."
dialogues.text:
"I want to live a meaningful life. Sempai, please give me
more time..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Miharu."

dialogues.jp: ――ざざん。
dialogues.en: Whoosh.
dialogues.text: Whoosh.

dialogues.jp:
このまま、ふたりとも桜の海に溶けてしまえば
いいのに。
dialogues.en:
I wish she and I could just melt into the ocean of cherry
blossoms.
dialogues.text:
I wish she and I could just melt into the ocean of cherry
blossoms.

dialogues.jp:
永遠に咲き続ける不思議な桜は、俺の願いを聞
いてはくれないのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
I wonder if this ever-blooming cherry tree can grant my
wish.
dialogues.text:
I wonder if this ever-blooming cherry tree can grant my
wish.

dialogues.jp:
一年中景色の変わることのないこの場所のよう
に、このまま変わらないでいることはできない
のだろうか。
dialogues.en:
Can we stay the same just like this place, the place that
looks the same throughout the year?
dialogues.text:
Can we stay the same just like this place, the place that
looks the same throughout the year?

dialogues.jp:
何か聞こえた気がしたが、枝のざわめく音に、
かき消されてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I thought I heard something, but the murmur of the wind in
the trees drowned it out.
dialogues.text:
I thought I heard something, but the murmur of the wind in
the trees drowned it out.

dialogues.jp: ◆美春との思い出◆
dialogues.en: ◆Miharu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Miharu◆

dialogues.jp: 枯れない桜の下で美春を抱きしめた。
dialogues.en: "That's because graduation is only 2 days away."
dialogues.text: "That's because graduation is only 2 days away."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生には美春のことを止めないでほしい。そ
う言ったのに……。
dialogues.en:
After school Miharu and I are drinking tea in the biology
preparation room while teachers are in a meeting.
dialogues.text:
After school Miharu and I are drinking tea in the biology
preparation room while teachers are in a meeting.

dialogues.jp:
覚悟はしたつもりだったのに、感情は別だった。
ぎゅっと抱きしめた感触を、匂いを決して失い
たくない。
dialogues.en: "It's the day after tomorrow..."
dialogues.text: "It's the day after tomorrow..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は美春との思い出が欲しかった。
dialogues.en:
"I feel sad thinking that I'm leaving this campus in two
days."
dialogues.text:
"I feel sad thinking that I'm leaving this campus in two
days."

dialogues.jp: でも、美春はもう少し時間をくださいと言う。
dialogues.en:
"You're only going to the campus next door after
graduation."
dialogues.text:
"You're only going to the campus next door after
graduation."

dialogues.jp:
このまま、ふたりとも桜の海に溶けてしまえば
いいのに。そんなことを桜の木に願うのだった。
dialogues.en: "Haha."
dialogues.text: "Haha."
